title: An algebra embeds into its scalar extension by a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $K/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], and $B$ a commutative $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Equip $B\otimes_kK$ with its algebra tensor product structure [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property]. The canonical $k$-algebra map $B\to B\otimes_kK$, $b\mapsto b\otimes1$, is injective.
